channel.title: Ethan Li — English
channel.description: Researching and building AI agents, with a focus on evaluation, agent infrastructure, and coding agents.

item.title: Judgment Is Not a Moat, but a Water Source
item.description: As AI makes prediction and action cheap, what remains scarce is not a static capability but a loop that continually regenerates context, judgment, and accountability.

item.title: An Original Problem: Minimum Swap Distance for Pattern Elimination
item.description: Find the minimum number of arbitrary swaps needed to remove every occurrence of a pattern T, using occurrence blocks, DAG DP, and convex optimization.
